items.title: Frank Adams Interview, 1959-01-20
items.q: my dad told Mrs. Sacks, no, I'm not going to leave my house.

ctx.x: We'll have another chair, Bill. All right.
You were telling us about your neighbors and all up there at the time of that riot. Uh-huh. And so, my dad told Mrs. Sacks, no, I'm not going to leave my house.

He said, well, Adam, what you going to do? He said, of course, I'm going to fight. He said, I'm fighting until they kill me. I said, I'm going to fight for you all. be safe? Now, we the owners went in there, but the other colored folks were down in there, but he's going to protect them, but we the owners went in his house. Some of the white neighbors invited them to go over to their house.
